title: Celestin band members and their addresses
summary: Russell asks for addresses of band members; French names Joe Thomas, Jeanette and Norwood Kimball, Steele Davis and Sidney Brown.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: I'd like to inquire if you have a list of the addresses. We could even put it on the tape and then we can take it off of the tape. If you have the other members of the band that we've interviewed, I don't think I'd ever call him as Fernand as Mr. Walters. Walters, Alba Walters. We had a short interview with him and one with Louis Barbaran. And you I believe are the only members now that we've interviewed. Let's see there's…
Joe Thomas.
Joe Thomas. Somehow we've missed him all the time.
Yeah, Jeanette Kimball.
Jeanette Kimball. I don't have her address.
And I have the new bass player. Well I have a…
Oh yes, I don't know him. Norwood Kimball. Who is the bass player now?
Well Norwood Kimball and I have still two, Steele Davis you see. Out of town I mean Norwood plays out of town job with me and Steele Davis plays a job at any time.
We did interview Sidney Brown about two months ago. He did?
Yeah.
Before he went in the hospital. I understand he's been sick.
I haven't seen him since. He's been like he liked to… His eyesight went bad. Yeah. And he's in church too I guess and almost gave up playing now.
That's right.
He did fine. He still plays in church though. He still plays in church though.
He told me too he was going to play in church.
Yeah, he played in church. So Jeanette is not in town now. She's in Ohio. Oh she's not here now?
No she's not here now.
She stayed at I think 2012 7th Street. And Joe Thomas still St. Anne Street. I have to get his number. I don't have his number.
We have a union book. It's an old book though and half of those addresses people have moved. It's all different.
Yeah they're all there.
You know how musicians move around more than most people.

That's right. That's right. Well still Davis is still on Willow and Sonniac. I don't have a corner over here. Willow and Sonniac. I don't have his address. Not far from here. It's still in the downtown front of town side of the bank. It's right over here. Right over the next corner over there. You know what I asked? Yeah. I said Willow. And Upline. I don't have his number. Willow and Upline. I don't have his address.
Is this other bass player, what's his first name? Norwood Kimball. Norwood. Is he any relation to Jeanette Kimball or the other Kimballs?
I was a husband.
Oh.
Yes.
Husband and wife. Oh sure then. I didn't know his name was Norwood. Yeah. Norwood Kimball.
They were.
They were husband and wife. Yeah. I didn't know the relationship.
He had the same address. 2012 Louis Avenue. Oh yeah. So that's a cool answer then.
